notes:
- **Home keeps counting.** Words dictated, Time saved and Dictations come from daily totals that **History kept** never deletes, so they no longer fall back when old dictations are trimmed, and a change can't equal the total any more. Counting starts from the dictations History still held when you updated; ones deleted earlier can't be recovered.
- **A range switch above Home's tiles:** 7 days, 30 days or All time (the default), remembered. All time shows "+X last 7 days" under each number; the other two compare with the days before ("▲ 18% vs prior 7 days", or "First week" when there is nothing before). Notes recorded follows the same range.
- **Settings › General › Reset counts** starts Home's counts again from zero and leaves History alone. **Clear all** in Transcribe leaves them alone too, and says so.
- **Words this week** on the Transcribe screen reads the same counts as Home, so the two agree.
